# filters.chat

Select events whose marked chat ID equals any supplied numeric ID.

## Signature

```python
def filters.chat(*ids: int) -> Filter
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Python type | Default | Passing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ids` | `int` | `Required` | Variadic positional |

### ids

One or more marked numeric chat IDs matched against event.chat_id. User IDs are positive, basic groups negative, channels -(1000000000000 + channel_id). No network lookup is done.

## Returns

Composable synchronous Filter.

## Example

```python
from gramflux import Client, Session, buttons, filters
from gramflux.raw import types

@client.on_message(filters.chat(-1001234567890) & filters.text)
async def handler(event):
    print(event.chat_id)
```

## Constraints and failure behavior

No usernames, I/O or peer resolution occurs. Compose with sender/text predicates using &, | and ~.

These examples assume a previously constructed client where one is used. Builders and selectors do not make a network request by themselves. Invalid builder/selector inputs raise ConfigurationError or the underlying Python argument/regex error. Session I/O errors arise when storage is actually opened during connect.
